name: GL_JE_INCLUSION_RULES_
description: GL_JE_INCLUSION_RULES contains a set of journal sources and categories to be included/excluded for various kinds of processing, such as propagation to reporting currencies and secondary ledgers.INCLUDE_FLAG indicates if a particular source and category combination is to be included (Y) or excluded (N) for processing.Rules defined in this table could be entered by user or system generated. System generated rules cannot be modified by the user. USER_UPDATABLE_FLAG indicates if a user can modify the rule or not.

columns.name: JE_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Journal inclusion rule set identifier.

columns.description: Journal source. Foreign key to GL_JE_SOURCES_B.

columns.description: Journal category. Foreign key to GL_JE_CATEGORIES_B.

columns.name: USER_UPDATABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the user can update the rule.

columns.name: INCLUDE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicate whether this journal source or category will be included or excluded for processing.
